issuers.regulatoryStatus: Base Prospectus approved by the Liechtenstein Financial Market Authority (FMA) on 8 May 2026 (FMA certificate of approval ref. 20260508_384472) under EU Prospectus Regulation 2017/1129, valid to 7 May 2027; the PDF Backed serves under the "Base Prospectus (2026/05/08)" label (..._Base Prospectus_20260727.pdf) is the consolidated version incorporating the First Supplement of 27 July 2026, and its cover date line is blank, passported into 29 EEA states. JFSC has consented under Arts. 2 and 4 of the Control of Borrowing (Jersey) Order 1958 and the issuer is registered with the JFSC under the Proceeds of Crime (Supervisory Bodies) (Jersey) Law 2008 — but the prospectus states expressly that 'this consent does not give the issuer a regulated status'. Swiss offering limited to professional investors under Art. 4(3)-(5) FinSA. EU/EEA distribution is via a Cyprus-regulated investment firm (xstocks.fi).
issuers.holderClaim: The holder owns a bearer debt instrument classified as a tracker certificate — a ledger-based security (Registerwertrecht) giving a claim against the Issuer for a cash Redemption Amount tracking one share of the underlying. The holder has a sole claim to the Collateral allocated to that specific Product (via a pledge held by a Security Agent) and no claim to other Products' collateral or to the Issuer's other assets; no shareholder, dividend, participation or voting rights. The prospectus route is cash-settled and excludes physical delivery. Separately, the operational xPort channel lets a participant onboarded with both Backed and Alpaca send tokens from a whitelisted wallet and receive the corresponding shares in that participant's Alpaca brokerage account; this is a gated primary-market service, not an unconditional right carried by the token.
issuers.underlyingCustodian: Per product Final Terms, the current Base Prospectus names as Custodians: InCore Bank AG (Swiss custodian; contractually barred from securities lending or proprietary transactions with the Underlyings and from asserting liens), Maerki Baumann & Co. AG, GTN Europe Financial Services Limited (UK, FCA firm reference 1003343) and — as U.S. Custodian — Alpaca Crypto LLC, a FinCEN-registered money services business in San Mateo, California, which may hold Investor cryptocurrency in omnibus accounts and delegate custody functions to sub-custodians at its own discretion. Alpaca Securities LLC is named in the same prospectus not as Custodian but as U.S. Broker (SEC-registered broker-dealer, FINRA member, SEC Rule 15c3-3 compliant) and as Prime Borrower under the Master Securities Lending Agreement. DISCREPANCY: the TSLAx product page (stamped 'Last updated on June 30, 2025') still lists Alpaca Securities LLC under 'Custodian' and does not mention Alpaca Crypto LLC at all. Issuer may change custodians and custody jurisdictions at its sole discretion on notice.

custodyVerification.agent: The Network Firm (attestation API with read-only access to Backed's custody bank accounts); relayed on-chain by Chainlink Proof of Reserve

custodyVerification.notes: The official v2 API publishes timestamped sharesHeld, circulatingSupply and per-provider holdings; providers observed on 2026-09-20 include Alpaca and GTN. A complete paginated read returned 826 symbol rows for 828 current registry products even though the pagination metadata claimed 926: FGDLx and NWGx were absent. Of the 826 returned rows, 725 reported positive circulation and 101 reported zero; none reported sharesHeld below circulatingSupply. This resolves the former REST-endpoint gap, but it is issuer-served, symbol-keyed data rather than a signed independent report or an exact-mint attestation. No per-ticker Solana Chainlink PoR feed address could be confirmed from a primary source, and no signed periodic attestation report PDFs (AICPA examination or AUP) were found. The prospectus also promises lent-underlying amounts 'on a regular basis on their website' and none were found in this endpoint or on product pages. No public smart-contract audit was found.

redemption.eligibility: Investor Put Option exercisable at any time by any Investor, but acceptance is conditional on successfully completing the Issuer's KYC/AML procedures, and the Issuer may reject a redemption request on negative findings. Primary-market access requires onboarding with the issuer and only whitelisted wallets may interact with the platform. Qualified Professional Investors may subscribe directly; all investor segments may go through an Authorized Participant.
redemption.rails: The prospectus Investor Put route is cash settlement in the Settlement Currency (optionally other fiat or cryptocurrencies at the Issuer's sole discretion) by T+5 from receipt of the tokens; tokens are de-activated and collateral liquidated, and physical delivery is excluded for that route. Separately, xPort is a live in-kind channel: a client onboarded with both Backed and Alpaca sends xStocks from a whitelisted wallet, Backed processes them, and Alpaca returns the corresponding underlying shares to the client's brokerage account. xPort is advertised as 24/5 with fees currently set to zero.
redemption.fees: Per-product (TSLAx product page): issuance/redemption up to 0.50% of investment value; management fee up to 0.25% p.a. (currently none). The Base Prospectus caps are an order of magnitude higher: Investor Fees for issuance and redemption 'of up to 5% of the market price of the Underlying' (s.1.3 definitions), and a surcharge on issue and redemption price that 'shall not exceed 5% of the redemption price and/or a Management Fee, which shall not exceed 5% p.a.' (s.3.1.1.8). The product-page figures are current values, not ceilings.

This establishes a currently documented route, not a completed user redemption.

issuers.corporateActions: Handled by an on-chain rebasing multiplier. Cash dividends are reinvested into additional shares of the same stock, net of applicable withholding taxes, and the multiplier increases; splits increase and reverse splits decrease the multiplier proportionally. On Solana the multiplier lives in the Token-2022 scaledUiAmountConfig extension (verified on-chain: AAPLx multiplier 1.0026642075893797 with a scheduled newMultiplier 1.0032690125398187) rather than by minting/burning supply. Delisting is not addressed in the public docs pages but IS addressed in the Base Prospectus: a delisting is an Adjustment Event under Terms and Conditions clause IX.i, and if the Underlying ceases to be traded or publicly quoted and is not immediately re-quoted this is a Termination Event at the Issuer's sole discretion under clause IX.iii, whereupon the Product is terminated and the Issuer pays what it alone determines is the fair market value. Mergers are never named; clause IX.v extends the same rules mutatis mutandis to any event that 'in the sole opinion of the Issuer' has an equivalent effect. Under clause IX.vi the consent of Investors is not required for any of these changes.

pricing.notes: Chainlink is the official oracle infrastructure for xStocks pricing. Primary-market issuance/redemption against the issuer at underlying value provides the arbitrage channel, but only for KYC'd, whitelisted participants and Authorized Participants — retail secondary holders cannot arbitrage directly. Prospectus commits the Issuer to publish an explanation if an exchange-listed Product trades at +/-2% or more to the underlying for seven consecutive trading days.

openQuestions: Does Backed actually publish the amount of Lent Underlyings 'on a regular basis on their website' as the prospectus promises? Not found on the product pages or the PoR dashboard — and whether lending is enabled per-Product is set in each product's Final Terms, which could not be downloaded (the product page's document links are unpopulated placeholders).
Are the per-ticker Chainlink Proof of Reserve feeds live on Solana specifically, and what are their feed account addresses? Only the marketing claim and the SPA dashboard were verifiable.
Are there signed periodic attestation reports (AICPA examination or agreed-upon-procedures) from The Network Firm for xStocks, or only the live API feeding Chainlink? No report PDFs were found.
Which product Final Terms name which custodian, and what share of collateral sits in the US structure (Alpaca) versus Swiss (InCore, Maerki Baumann) versus UK (GTN Europe)?

Is the structure genuinely bankruptcy-remote? The prospectus never uses the phrase — it describes an SPV plus a per-product pledge and account control agreement. The xStocks docs page claims bankruptcy-remoteness. Treated here as null pending a legal opinion.

Has the Kraken/Payward acquisition changed key custody, and who beneficially controls the four members of Squads multisig 8gep9m2... and the separate mint/delegate keys? The freeze/pause mechanics are now resolved as a 2-of-4 multisig with no timelock, but member identities remain unpublished. The rebase key S7vYFF... is one of those members while retaining a separate unilateral rebase power.

ANSWERED (2026-09-20): xPort means token-for-share, not token-for-token. The current official xPort page says a dually onboarded Backed/Alpaca client sends xStocks from a whitelisted wallet and Alpaca returns the corresponding underlying shares to that client's brokerage account. The prospectus Investor Put remains cash-settled and excludes physical delivery, so these are distinct gated primary-market routes rather than an unconditional bearer redemption right.

What is the current legal and operational status of IVZx, GMEDx, DOCUx, ARWRx and the older TEFx mint Xszk5DE...? All five use the ordinary xStocks mint, freeze and permanent-delegate authorities, remain unpaused, have non-zero on-chain supply and still return issuer-hosted metadata, but none appears in the current public asset registry. Four symbols are absent from the reserve feed. TEFx has been replaced in the registry by mint XsUShG8..., while the symbol-only reserve row cannot distinguish old from new. Can holders of the old addresses still use the cash Investor Put or xPort, and if not, what process extinguishes those outstanding tokens?

Has Backed's custody arrangement actually been amended to bind it to follow token-holder voting instructions? A secondary report (crypto.news, https://crypto.news/kraken-xstocks-tokenized-equity-voting-rights/, article footer 'Published August 6, 2026' and cited elsewhere in this dossier as 7 August 2026) says the contractual terms of Backed Assets (JE) Limited's custody arrangement were updated to create a binding obligation to vote the underlying shares per instructions submitted through Kraken accounts and aggregated on Ink. No primary source for it was found: the FMA-approved Base Prospectus, the xStocks docs, the xStocks FAQ, Kraken's live risk disclosure and Kraken's support FAQ all still say the tokens confer no voting rights as at 2026-09-18. The dossier's voting: "none" stands until a primary source appears; if one does, voting, holderClaim and the titleDeed/attestation wording all change.

keyGovernance.evidence: Finalized getMultipleAccounts across the issuer's 828-address registry on 2026-09-20 found one shared mint key, one shared freeze+pause key, one shared permanent-delegate+hook-authority key and one shared rebase key across all 828 mints. The freeze/pause address JDq14BWvqCRFNu1krb12bcRpbGtJZ1FLEakMw6FdxJNs is vault index 0 of Squads v4 multisig 8gep9m2BmCqz4qCQMcqZoqnaGedXgRWehFYhKaPuiu8X. Its finalized 561-byte account decodes to threshold 2 of 4, timeLock 0, default configAuthority (configuration changes go through the multisig), and four full-permission members: S7vYFFWH6BjJyEsdrPQpqpYTqLTrPRK6KW3VwsJuRaS, 2emBpySXN5p1YadehxEcS247NMjH3Ve2vbhpq2ikGR3D, 5wjPY71YCgcAK5YYmcdhXVD26rWgGtYsNSJX6b69Cvcb and HxszS1heZvNLqMDETZeUtQw6PFzkovnGKv5HpPTouPNq. Their beneficial identities remain unpublished. The mint key 7pt9tkctJPK7PPNQJ77GKg8ZffSF6QxoMiCFYHxrtaCj is a plain funded wallet running daily mintTo, with no multisig in its history. The permanent-delegate/hook key 5aMNNLQJwAEeoemTEMkv5NVjqKwvvefRYCQ5Z67HFvEq is vault index 0 of a second Squads v4 multisig, Dsm8Dmh6ip3pc19G3oB3FBc2Kx7A9sQBSA2akD2Jraot: threshold 2 of 3, timeLock 0, default configAuthority, members 49pmqovsRrPoKcrxULMXjFizFHuDD3AtKzwodkzweUZv, 82s7WdW9X8RKfxhR2C2YHnSj1vd6Rinpiwc8eREH7MNN and FN5JKy3ySbUH2QoCc329ni75oz76t7qFFg6xGfWkq68t, none of whom is a member of the freeze multisig; their beneficial identities are unpublished. The same vault is metadata-update and confidential-transfer authority. New mints are created by S7vYFF..., which names the vault as permanent delegate; the vault itself has never signed a transaction directly, and across all 1,844 transactions that touch it from 2025-06-10 to 2026-09-18 no transfer or burn names it as authority, so the permanent-delegate power had not been exercised on Solana by that date. The rebase authority S7vYFFWH6BjJyEsdrPQpqpYTqLTrPRK6KW3VwsJuRaS is shared by all 828 mints and is also one of the four Squads members, but its separate rebase power is unilateral: it signs Token-2022 transactions directly with no multisig program. One signature from it can restate every holder's displayed balance across the programme.

blockchainIsMainLedger.reason: Base Prospectus s.4.1.1: the Products are Ledger-Based Securities under Art. 973d et seqq. Swiss CO, registered in a distributed ledger serving as the 'Securities Ledger', and 'may be exercised and transferred freely to others only via this Securities Ledger. Thus, the securities are neither in certificated nor in book-entry form but in tokenized form.' 'The Securities Ledger serves as the source of truth in relation to transfer records.' There is no parallel authoritative register.

unconditionalTransfers.reason: Docs: xStocks are 'freely transferable onchain' and secondary trading 'does not require direct interaction with the issuer'. Verified on-chain for TSLAx/AAPLx: defaultAccountState = initialized (accounts are not frozen by default, so no allowlist), transferHook programId = null (no hook enforcing rules), no MemoTransfer/permissioned-transfer gate. Caveat: the mint carries a freezeAuthority and a pausableConfig, so the issuer can block transfers reactively — but no gatekeeper approval is required before a transfer.

bearerRedemption.reason: Redemption requires successful KYC/AML with the Issuer before the Products are accepted, only whitelisted wallets may interact with the primary-market platform, and the Issuer may reject a request on negative findings. Physical delivery of the underlying is expressly excluded — settlement is cash only, T+5. Presenting the token is not sufficient.

forcedTransfers.reason: Verified on-chain: the Token-2022 mints carry a permanentDelegate (5aMNNLQJwAEeoemTEMkv5NVjqKwvvefRYCQ5Z67HFvEq) which can transfer or burn tokens from any holder account without the holder's consent, plus a freezeAuthority and a pausableConfig (JDq14BWvqCRFNu1krb12bcRpbGtJZ1FLEakMw6FdxJNs). The legal side also has a Realization Event mechanism under which the Security Agent liquidates collateral and forces maturity.

titleDeed.reason: The token is a bearer debt instrument / tracker certificate, not the share. The prospectus states investors' rights 'do not consist of any shareholders' rights', excluding attendance, dividend payments, participation and voting, and investors 'are not entitled to any rights or claims to the Underlying ... or the Collateral aside from those described in the Terms and Conditions'. A derived economic claim, not full ownership.

tokenSelfCustody.reason: Base Prospectus s.3.17 names as an advantage 'the direct control of the ledger-based security by the Investor, as it may be held in an unhosted respectively non-custody wallet, which the Investor has exclusive access to'. Confirmed by on-chain state: ordinary Token-2022 accounts, not frozen by default.

issuerIndependent.reason: The token's value is a claim against the Issuer, an SPV that the prospectus says is 'currently not profitable', depends on parent financing, whose reserves 'remain limited, which may result in the inability of the Issuer to continue as a going concern', and whose obligations are not guaranteed by Payward/PEL. Rebasing and redemption both require issuer action; the scaledUiAmount multiplier authority is issuer-controlled. Mitigated but not cured by the product-specific pledge to the Security Agent, who on a Realization Event liquidates and distributes cash — the token then ceases to track anything.

presetJurisdiction.reason: Base Prospectus clause XXVIII: the Products and the rights and obligations of the Issuer and each holder 'shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of Jersey', with non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Jersey; the Registration Agreement is governed by Swiss law (Art. 973d CO). Unambiguous and published.

thirdPartyAttestations.reason: Chainlink Proof of Reserve publishes reserve figures on-chain, sourced from an attestation API operated by The Network Firm, which holds read-only access to Backed's custody bank accounts; updated daily or on a >10% reserve change. Independent of the issuer. Weakness: no signed periodic examination/AUP report was found published, and no public smart-contract audit exists.

aiReady.reason: Per the vocabulary formula: unconditionalTransfers = yes and tokenSelfCustody = yes. No KYC is in the secondary transfer or holding loop; an agent can acquire and hold xStocks on a DEX. KYC only gates the primary market (mint/redeem).

reflectLegalDecisions.reason: The permanentDelegate plus freeze and pause authorities give the issuer on-chain means to implement a court order (seizure, reversal, recovery), and the legal layer provides a Security Agent with account control to enforce against the collateral. Whether the issuer would act on a foreign court order is undocumented, but the capability exists.

meetingOfMinds.reason: A secondary transfer settles on buyer/seller agreement alone — no issuer, platform or regulator sign-off is required, and the docs state secondary trading 'does not require direct interaction with the issuer'. The prospectus recognises the ledger transfer as the legally effective transfer of the security.

findings.quote: Pursuant to a Master Securities Lending Agreement (the “Securities Lending Agreement”), the Issuer agrees to lend to the Prime Borrower all or part of the Underlyings of a specific Product.
findings.statement: Under a Master Securities Lending Agreement the Issuer may lend all or part of a Product's Underlyings to Alpaca Securities LLC as Prime Borrower where the Final Terms allow. Lent Underlyings leave the Standard Collateral Accounts, are released from the pledge and cease to qualify as Collateral; they are replaced by cash counter-collateral equal to Outstanding Value, marked to market daily.

findings.quote: Physical delivery of the Underlyings and/or Collateral is excluded and Investors' interests are settled in FIAT currency and/or cryptocurrencies in the event of a redemption or termination.
findings.statement: 'Physical delivery of the Underlyings and/or Collateral is excluded and Investors' interests are settled in FIAT currency and/or cryptocurrencies.' Redemption is KYC-gated, returns cash at T+5 with a fee up to 0.50%, and the issuer may reject the request.

findings.quote: Whilst this consent does not give the issuer a ‘regulated’ status, it mandates a set of conditions designed to ensure that the issuer meets specific standards in terms of governance, investor disclosure and AML/CFT/CPF compliance.
findings.statement: The JFSC has consented under the Control of Borrowing (Jersey) Order 1958 and the issuer is AML-registered, but the prospectus states expressly that 'this consent does not give the issuer a regulated status', and neither the Registrar nor the JFSC takes responsibility for the Issuer's financial soundness.

findings.statement: Only 5 of 441 tokens had an entitled Pyth feed, so xStocks premiums were computed against an underlying price implied from a competitor's API (Ondo's marketCap/sharesOutstanding), which is daily-ish and, for ETFs, shares-based rather than NAV.

findings.quote: IVZx, GMEDx, DOCUx, ARWRx and the older TEFx mint were absent from the issuer's 828-address public asset registry; the reserve API is keyed by symbol rather than mint and therefore cannot distinguish the old TEFx address from its current replacement.
findings.statement: Five genuine xStocks-programme mints are still unpaused and have non-zero Token-2022 supply, and their issuer-hosted metadata remains reachable, but all five are absent from the current asset registry. IVZx, GMEDx, DOCUx and ARWRx are absent from the reserve feed too. TEFx now has a different current mint (XsUShG8...), while the reserve feed exposes only the symbol, 2 shares held and zero circulation, so it cannot prove which TEFx mint that row describes. The issuer needs to clarify whether the old addresses are retired, what their holders can redeem, and why supply remains non-zero.

keyGovernance.evidence: Finalized getMultipleAccounts across the issuer's 828-address registry on 2026-09-20 found one shared mint key, one shared freeze+pause key, one shared permanent-delegate+hook-authority key and one shared rebase key across all 828 mints. The freeze/pause address JDq14BWvqCRFNu1krb12bcRpbGtJZ1FLEakMw6FdxJNs is vault index 0 of Squads v4 multisig 8gep9m2BmCqz4qCQMcqZoqnaGedXgRWehFYhKaPuiu8X. Its finalized 561-byte account decodes to threshold 2 of 4, timeLock 0, default configAuthority (configuration changes go through the multisig), and four full-permission members: S7vYFFWH6BjJyEsdrPQpqpYTqLTrPRK6KW3VwsJuRaS, 2emBpySXN5p1YadehxEcS247NMjH3Ve2vbhpq2ikGR3D, 5wjPY71YCgcAK5YYmcdhXVD26rWgGtYsNSJX6b69Cvcb and HxszS1heZvNLqMDETZeUtQw6PFzkovnGKv5HpPTouPNq. Their beneficial identities remain unpublished. The mint key 7pt9tkctJPK7PPNQJ77GKg8ZffSF6QxoMiCFYHxrtaCj is a plain funded wallet running daily mintTo, with no multisig in its history. The permanent-delegate/hook key 5aMNNLQJwAEeoemTEMkv5NVjqKwvvefRYCQ5Z67HFvEq is vault index 0 of a second Squads v4 multisig, Dsm8Dmh6ip3pc19G3oB3FBc2Kx7A9sQBSA2akD2Jraot: threshold 2 of 3, timeLock 0, default configAuthority, members 49pmqovsRrPoKcrxULMXjFizFHuDD3AtKzwodkzweUZv, 82s7WdW9X8RKfxhR2C2YHnSj1vd6Rinpiwc8eREH7MNN and FN5JKy3ySbUH2QoCc329ni75oz76t7qFFg6xGfWkq68t, none of whom is a member of the freeze multisig; their beneficial identities are unpublished. The same vault is metadata-update and confidential-transfer authority. New mints are created by S7vYFF..., which names the vault as permanent delegate; the vault itself has never signed a transaction directly, and across all 1,844 transactions that touch it from 2025-06-10 to 2026-09-18 no transfer or burn names it as authority, so the permanent-delegate power had not been exercised on Solana by that date. The rebase authority S7vYFFWH6BjJyEsdrPQpqpYTqLTrPRK6KW3VwsJuRaS is shared by all 828 mints and is also one of the four Squads members, but its separate rebase power is unilateral: it signs Token-2022 transactions directly with no multisig program. One signature from it can restate every holder's displayed balance across the programme.

fields.value: Investor Put Option exercisable at any time by any Investor, but acceptance is conditional on successfully completing the Issuer's KYC/AML procedures, and the Issuer may reject a redemption request on negative findings. Primary-market access requires onboarding with the issuer and only whitelisted wallets may interact with the platform. Qualified Professional Investors may subscribe directly; all investor segments may go through an Authorized Participant.

The prospectus Investor Put route is cash settlement in the Settlement Currency (optionally other fiat or cryptocurrencies at the Issuer's sole discretion) by T+5 from receipt of the tokens; tokens are de-activated and collateral liquidated, and physical delivery is excluded for that route. Separately, xPort is a live in-kind channel: a client onboarded with both Backed and Alpaca sends xStocks from a whitelisted wallet, Backed processes them, and Alpaca returns the corresponding underlying shares to the client's brokerage account. xPort is advertised as 24/5 with fees currently set to zero.

Per-product (TSLAx product page): issuance/redemption up to 0.50% of investment value; management fee up to 0.25% p.a. (currently none). The Base Prospectus caps are an order of magnitude higher: Investor Fees for issuance and redemption 'of up to 5% of the market price of the Underlying' (s.1.3 definitions), and a surcharge on issue and redemption price that 'shall not exceed 5% of the redemption price and/or a Management Fee, which shall not exceed 5% p.a.' (s.3.1.1.8). The product-page figures are current values, not ceilings.

USD 5,000 per transaction when issuing or redeeming directly with the Issuer (xStocks FAQ), retail users included; no minimum is imposed by the Issuer on secondary markets. The Base Prospectus itself sets no size floor — fractional ledger-based securities are possible, the Redemption Amount must be at least the smallest denomination of the Settlement Currency, and excess rounding amounts are kept by the Issuer — so the 5,000 floor exists only in the FAQ.

links.label: Dividends and cash entitlements

fields.value: Handled by an on-chain rebasing multiplier. Cash dividends are reinvested into additional shares of the same stock, net of applicable withholding taxes, and the multiplier increases; splits increase and reverse splits decrease the multiplier proportionally. On Solana the multiplier lives in the Token-2022 scaledUiAmountConfig extension (verified on-chain: AAPLx multiplier 1.0026642075893797 with a scheduled newMultiplier 1.0032690125398187) rather than by minting/burning supply. Delisting is not addressed in the public docs pages but IS addressed in the Base Prospectus: a delisting is an Adjustment Event under Terms and Conditions clause IX.i, and if the Underlying ceases to be traded or publicly quoted and is not immediately re-quoted this is a Termination Event at the Issuer's sole discretion under clause IX.iii, whereupon the Product is terminated and the Issuer pays what it alone determines is the fair market value. Mergers are never named; clause IX.v extends the same rules mutatis mutandis to any event that 'in the sole opinion of the Issuer' has an equivalent effect. Under clause IX.vi the consent of Investors is not required for any of these changes.
